description: This PHP source file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically handling the commit JSON operations in the UpgradeWizard module. It manages different steps in the upgrade process via switch cases based on request parameters, and logs actions accordingly.

methods.name: getPersistence
methods.description: Retrieves the persistence object or data used to maintain state during the upgrade process.

methods.name: commitAjaxRunSql
methods.description: Executes SQL commands as part of the upgrade process.

methods.name: commitAjaxGetSqlErrors
methods.description: Fetches errors related to SQL commands during upgrade.

methods.name: commitAjaxFinalTouches
methods.description: Carries out final steps to complete the upgrade process.

methods.name: logThis
methods.description: Logs messages for debugging or auditing.
